item.title: Woodland Christian boys and girls soccer teams qualify for CIF Sac-Joaquin Section D6 playoffs
item.description: Both the Woodland Christian boys and girls soccer teams just wrapped up fantastic seasons, earning respective playoff berths to the CIF Sac-Joaquin Section Division VI playoffs. While the girls season ended on Friday night, the boys automatically advance to the second round thanks to a first-round bye and will play on Tuesday.

item.title: Woodland Camera Forum presentation set for Feb. 16
item.description: The Woodland Camera Forum will present a free photographic travel presentation on Patagonia, Chile, by photographer and traveler Robert Norris on Monday, Feb. 16 at the Living Hope Church — located at 240 N. West St. in Woodland, starting at 7 p.m.

item.title: Yolo County nonprofits to host pizza and movie night set for Tuesday, Feb. 17
item.description: Yolo County residents can join “Pizza and a Movie Night” next Tuesday at Woodland Community College to learn more about civic engagement. The free event is scheduled for Feb. 17 from 5 p.m. to 8 p.m.

item.title: Pioneer High School girls basketball team falls just short on Senior Night with loss to River City
item.description: Despite a fantastic game and a great effort for all four quarters, the Pioneer High School girls' basketball team was unable to wrap up the regular season with a nice, neat bow, losing a close 44-38 game on the team's Senior Night to Monticello Empire League foe River City Friday night.
